name: round 1: the fight
tests: an empty fight prints the starting state: no winner, 100 hp each, player 1 at -150 and player 2 at 150
walking moves 3 units forward and 2 back per frame, within the stage and never closer than 60
a left punch in range hits on its 7th frame for 5 damage, and only once
an attack hits only within its range: at 123 units a middle kick misses and a high kick hits
holding back blocks high and mid attacks for no damage, but low kicks still hit
a hit cancels the defender's attack: it does no damage
a knockout ends the round, and the next round starts after the 90-frame pause at full hp
the first fighter to win 2 rounds wins the match, and later frames change nothing
after 3600 frames the round ends by time, won by the fighter with more hp
the same inputs print the same bytes
refuses bad input files with exit code 2, a reason on stderr and nothing on stdout
the built page loads offline with no error, loads the model and reports ready with webgpu or webgl2
the keyboard walks player 1 forward with KeyD and player 2 forward with ArrowLeft
gamepads walk the players: player 1 with the stick of gamepad 0, player 2 with the d-pad of gamepad 1
